sloka: मया विरहितां दीनां वर्तमानां महावने ।वैदेहीं प्रसभं हृत्वा शूरो ऽहमिति मन्यसे ।। ६.१०५.१२ ।।
transliteration: mayā virahitāṁ dīnāṁ vartamānāṁ mahāvane ।vaidehīṁ prasabhaṁ hṛtvā śūro 'hamiti manyase ।। 6.105.12 ।।

translations.english: "Having abducted Vaidehi living in the forest by force, when she was desperate and separated from me, do you think that you are a hero?
